falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 73% bottom pattern match, as that prior bottom held at ~4,800; this would prove the structural support failed and the current signal is not a bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained VIX above 35 would indicate panic-driven selling rather than the controlled consolidation typical of the August 2024 bottom pattern; this would falsify the low-blowoff-score thesis (43) by confirming genuine fear escalation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.50% at any point in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-quality bid driving yields below 3.50% would signal recession/deleveraging panic, invalidating the bottom call which requires rates stability or modest rise to confirm growth scare resolution rather than economic collapse

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
